Here we want to summarise discussions about the structure of the package, design decisions around functions, and their relationship with the cross-referencing process.

## User journey

- Data preparation
- Validation
- Exploration
- Within round: Agreement and disagreement
- Between rounds
- Synthesis and outputs

### Validation pipeline

```{dot}
//| label: fig-validation
//| fig-cap: "Validation pipeline: functions, classes, methods and their relationship during a cycle of validation."
digraph membership {

// classes
node [shape=record fillcolor="#fff4d6", color="#8a5a00", fontcolor="#8a5a00", penwidth=2];
MT[label=<{Class <i>membership_tbl</i>|(not documented)}>]
MC[label=<{Class <i>membership_check</i>|(not documented)}>]
LUT[label=<{Class <i>lookup_tbl</i>|(not documented)}>]

// methods
node [shape=box fillcolor="#ddffdd", color="#004400", fontcolor="#004400", penwidth=2];
LUTP[label=<print(<i>lookup_tbl</i>)>]
MTP[label=<print(<i>membership_tbl</i>)>] 
MCP[label=<print(<i>membership_check</i>)>] 
// 
node [shape=record fillcolor="#e3edfb", color="#1f4e99", fontcolor="#1f4e99", penwidth=2];
ASMT[label=<{<i>as_membership_tbl()</i>|Coerce a data frame<BR/>to membership_tbl}>];
CHECKMT[label=<{<i>check_membership()</i>|Performs checks on a<BR/>membership table}>];
LUTF[label=<{<i>lookup_tbl()</i>|Create a lookup table<BR/>for a classification}>];
MTF[label=<{<i>membership_tbl()</i>|Create a membership table}>];
VMT[label=<{<i>validate_membership()</i>|Validate a membership table}>];

subgraph cluster_prep {
    label="Data validation pipeline"; 
    MT -> CHECKMT [label=input];
    LUTF -> LUT [label=creates];
    LUT -> CHECKMT [label=<input<BR/>(optional)>];
    CHECKMT -> MC -> VMT;
    LUT -> LUTP [label=<has method>]
    MC -> MCP [label=<has method>]
    VMT -> ASMT;
    ASMT -> MTF;
    subgraph cluster_main {
        label="Core functions" style=dashed;
        MT -> MTP [label=<has method>];
        MTF -> MT [label=creates];
    }
}
}
```
